description: Recent SFDA drug approvals in Saudi Arabia (sourced from www.sfda.gov.sa/en/new-sfda-drug-approvals): request type, drug type, trade name, scientific name, strength, dosage form, approval date. Newest first. Note: the SFDA leaves approval_date blank on the newest rows for a while — an empty date means SFDA has not published it yet, not a missing drug.

page.description: Page number, zero-indexed (each page has 10-20 rows). Default 0.

scientific_name.description: Filter by scientific (generic) name substring, e.g. "semaglutide".

name: sfda_drug_approvals
title: Sfda Drug Approvals
